slowest_experiments.experiment: V625 execution-time SOTA ingestion and method map
V625 Markdown and YAML task-contract preflight

summary: Three experiments used 0.7 minutes overall, and two were compute-bound. V625 execution-time SOTA ingestion and method map led the compute-bound entries at 0.66 minutes, while Adapter-withheld ARC leave-one-game-out shard A recorded 0.0 minutes; the supplied records do not identify the causal phase.
bottlenecks_identified: V625 execution-time SOTA ingestion and method map set the measured critical path at 0.66 minutes, but no phase-level breakdown is available to explain why.
Operational attribution is incomplete because the point-in-time GPU snapshot is not aligned to experiment execution and the data contains no model-count or runner-selection receipt.
improvements_suggested: Add phase-level timers to execution-time SOTA ingestion and method-map construction.
Capture GPU utilization during each compute-bound task and key every sample to the task name and execution window.
Emit model-count and runner-selection receipts at launch, using DualGPURunner only when at least two models are loaded in parallel.
Cache unchanged ingestion inputs and method-map outputs, and record cache hit and miss timings.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument task-scoped phase and GPU spans for every compute-bound experiment.
Cache unchanged SOTA ingestion and method-map products.
Record model count and runner choice at launch so parallel workloads can be routed and audited correctly.
meta_reflection: The critical path can be named but not causally explained from the available evidence. The locked compute-task idle classification is false, and no evidence of a task loading at least two models supports a missed DualGPURunner claim.
